targets.authors: Paternoster R, McGloin JM, Nguyen H, Thomas KJ.
targets.title: The causal impact of exposure to deviant peers: An experimental investigation.
targets.evidence_quote: The aim of this study was to replicate the effect of a brief exposure to a deviant peer found in Paternoster et al. ( 2013 ), using the same design in a different sample.
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, this study replicates the finding that a brief exposure to deviant modeling by a previously unknown peer subsequently increases the amount of deviant behavior in young adults. However, we did not replicate the finding that only participants who were exposed to a deviant peer engaged in deviancy.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion confirms the amount-of-deviancy effect and explicitly says the exclusivity of deviancy to exposed participants did not replicate.

reasoning: New Dutch university sample re-tests Paternoster et al. (2013). Gallupe et al. is described as prior related experimental work, not the study this experiment re-tests.
